blocks.text:
## Trip highlights

In Rio, 2 private tours are planned: Corcovado with the statue of Christ the Redeemer, and Sugarloaf Mountain. They offer different panoramas of the city, bay, beaches and mountains.

São Paulo unfolds through its architecture. One full day is devoted to modernism and the work of renowned Brazilian architects; the second follows a classic city route through Ibirapuera, Jardins, Vila Madalena, Avenida Paulista and the historic centre.

In Salvador, the focus shifts to colonial architecture and Afro-Brazilian heritage. After the tour, the group travels along the coast to Praia do Forte, where 2 days are left free.

## Accommodation

- Arena Leme, Rio de Janeiro, 3 nights.
- Slaviero São Paulo Ibirapuera, São Paulo, 3 nights.
- Vila Gale Salvador, Salvador, 1 night.
- Pousada Casa do Forte, Praia do Forte, 3 nights.
